example_sentences.de: Wofür brauchst du dieses Formular?
example_sentences.en: What do you need this form for?

example_sentences.de: Wofür ist dieser Knopf?
example_sentences.en: What is this button for?

words.notes: The wo(r)- pattern, which has no English equivalent: German does not say 'für was', it glues the preposition onto wo-. für + was = wofür, mit + was = womit, zu + was = wozu. Before a vowel an r is inserted: auf + was = worauf. This only works for things — for people the preposition stays separate: 'Für wen ist das?'
words.mnemonic: Flip 'für was' around and you get 'wo-für'.

example_sentences.de: Womit kann ich Ihnen helfen?
example_sentences.en: What can I help you with?

example_sentences.de: Womit fährst du zur Arbeit?
example_sentences.en: What do you get to work with?

cloze.en: What did you pay for the parcel with?

words.notes: womit = 'mit was'. Sloppy spoken German does say 'mit was', but womit is the correct form. For people it stays split and takes the dative: 'Mit wem gehst du?'
words.mnemonic: mit + was → wo-mit; the wo- always jumps to the front.
words.germany_context: 'Womit kann ich Ihnen helfen?' is the standard opening line at a Bürgeramt counter, a bank or a shop. Have your request ready in one short sentence.

example_sentences.de: Worum geht es in dem Brief?
example_sentences.en: What is the letter about?

example_sentences.de: Worum hat dich dein Chef gebeten?
example_sentences.en: What did your boss ask you for?

words.notes: um + was becomes worum, with an r inserted because um starts with a vowel. 'Worum geht es?' is the everyday way to ask what a matter is about; the answer is 'Es geht um …'.
words.mnemonic: wo + r + um — the r is only a bridge between two vowels.
words.germany_context: On the phone with an office or a doctor's practice you will almost always be asked 'Worum geht es?' before you are put through. Reply with 'Es geht um einen Termin.' or 'Es geht um meine Anmeldung.'

example_sentences.de: Worauf wartest du noch?
example_sentences.en: What are you still waiting for?

example_sentences.de: Worauf muss ich beim Mietvertrag achten?
example_sentences.en: What do I have to watch out for in the rental contract?

cloze.en: What are you looking forward to the most?

words.notes: auf + was becomes worauf, never 'auf was'. It belongs to verbs that take auf plus Akkusativ: warten auf, sich freuen auf, achten auf, antworten auf. For people: 'Auf wen wartest du?'
words.mnemonic: Say 'wo-auf' quickly and the r appears by itself: worauf.

example_sentences.de: Woran denkst du gerade?
example_sentences.en: What are you thinking about right now?

example_sentences.de: Woran liegt das?
example_sentences.en: What is the reason for that?

cloze.en: How do I recognise the right stop?

words.notes: an + was becomes woran. Used with denken an, liegen an, erkennen an, sich erinnern an. 'Woran liegt das?' is the normal way to ask what is causing a problem — much more idiomatic than 'Was ist der Grund?'
words.mnemonic: an → wor-an: the r slips in before the vowel.

example_sentences.de: Worüber habt ihr so lange gesprochen?
example_sentences.en: What did you talk about for so long?

example_sentences.de: Worüber ärgerst du dich?
example_sentences.en: What are you annoyed about?

cloze.en: What are you writing your term paper about?

words.notes: über + was becomes worüber. It goes with sprechen über, reden über, sich beschweren über, sich freuen über. Watch the pair: sich freuen ÜBER means about something that has happened, sich freuen AUF means looking forward to something.
words.mnemonic: über keeps its Umlaut inside the compound: wor-über.

example_sentences.de: Wozu brauchst du so viele Kartons?
example_sentences.en: What do you need so many boxes for?

example_sentences.de: Wozu dient dieses Formular?
example_sentences.en: What is this form used for?

cloze.en: What is that supposed to be good for?

words.notes: zu + was becomes wozu. Very close to wofür, but wozu asks about the purpose and wofür more about the target or beneficiary. Answer with 'Um … zu …': 'Wozu lernst du Deutsch?' — 'Um hier zu arbeiten.'
words.mnemonic: wozu ~ 'to what' — like the old English 'whereto'.

example_sentences.de: Weshalb haben Sie den Termin abgesagt?
example_sentences.en: Why did you cancel the appointment?

example_sentences.de: Ich weiß nicht, weshalb der Brief nicht angekommen ist.
example_sentences.en: I don't know why the letter didn't arrive.

cloze.en: Why didn't you call in sick?

words.notes: The third word for 'why', a shade more formal than warum and wieso — common in letters, forms and news. Like the others it pushes the verb to the end of a subordinate clause: 'Er sagt nicht, weshalb er kündigt.'
words.mnemonic: wes (old genitive of was) + halb ('because of') = 'because of what'.

example_sentences.de: Seit wann wohnen Sie in Deutschland?
example_sentences.en: How long have you been living in Germany?

example_sentences.de: Seit wann haben Sie diese Schmerzen?
example_sentences.en: How long have you had this pain?

cloze.en: How long has the lift been broken?

words.notes: Asks for the starting point of something that is still going on. The answer takes seit plus Dativ: 'Seit drei Tagen.' German uses the PRESENT tense here where English uses the perfect: 'Seit wann arbeitest du hier?'
words.mnemonic: seit points backwards into the past, ab points forwards into the future.
words.germany_context: A standard question at the doctor's: 'Seit wann haben Sie die Beschwerden?' Practise the answer as 'Seit drei Tagen.' — it is the first thing you will be asked.

example_sentences.de: Ab wann ist die Wohnung frei?
example_sentences.en: From when is the flat available?

example_sentences.de: Ab wann haben Sie morgen geöffnet?
example_sentences.en: From what time are you open tomorrow?

cloze.en: From when is the new contract valid?

words.notes: The mirror image of seit wann: it asks for a starting point in the future. The answer takes ab plus Dativ: 'Ab Montag.', 'Ab dem ersten September.'
words.mnemonic: ab = from now on; seit = ever since.
words.germany_context: You will use this constantly when flat hunting. Ads answer it in advance with 'frei ab 01.09.', and at a viewing 'Ab wann kann ich einziehen?' is the question that matters most after the rent.
